text:
Bitcoin surged past $69,250, breaking out of its multi-week consolidation following a landmark White House digital asset summit. The Roosevelt Room meeting brought together executive leadership and chief executives from Coinbase, Ripple, Kraken, and Robinhood to accelerate federal legislative momentum behind the CLARITY Act ahead of a key September Senate vote.

Concurrently, macroeconomic clarity emerged with the release of the July FOMC meeting minutes. The Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark rate at 3.50%–3.75% via a 9–3 vote, though hawkish dissents from regional presidents underscored ongoing debate over the terminal rate.

Traditional equity indices remain firm near record valuations while Treasury yields trade range-bound. However, cross-asset correlation is tightening as institutional allocators increasingly view regulatory clarity as a structural catalyst, positioning digital assets ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's upcoming Jackson Hole keynote on financial innovation.
